verbatim_lines: 事项：真实推理阶段遇到"模型答案被确定性后校验拒绝"时，是整轮作废，还是记为一条 extract_failed 继续跑完。
事实：今晚推理跑到第 811 个候选（news_item_id 5018）时，模型请求正常完成，但返回的股票代码不在原文里也不等于入库标的，
被登记的接地校验拒绝（retryable: false）。前 810 条全部正常，零重试。按预登记"任一候选失败即整轮终止、不抽样、不重试"，
整轮推理终止，工具目录已自封。已花 811 次调用约 11.3 元。
关键点：预登记里另有一条，早就为这种情况留了位置——extract_failed 单列一层，不进 60 条样本，如实上报，不算负例；
落地代码也已经这么写了。两条规则彼此矛盾，按实测频率（811 次 1 次），3958 个候选期望约 5 次，
不改的话这一轮永远跑不完。
提案（v5，只窄化一处）：请求已完成、输出被确定性后校验拒绝且不可重试时，记为 extract_failed 并继续；
该候选不进两个抽样层、不算负例、逐条上报 id 与原因。其余全部不变：传输错误、协议错误、可重试失败、任何重试仍整轮终止；
模型、提示、参数、数据窗口、40/20、种子、金标、阈值、请求顺序、每候选一次请求全部不动。
另设 extract_failed 比例上限 2%，超过则整轮终止并上报。
代价：v5 重跑一整轮 = 物化约 55 分钟 + 推理约 3.3 小时，约 55 元；落地链条约 2 小时。
需要业主的一句话：同意 v5 这样改，还是另有指示。（这是科学契约条款，不在常设授权范围内，我不能替业主决定。）

lanes.note: three paths, one lane; nothing the pass executes is touched

prepare_exception.note: This round changes no prepare bytes. The patch is empty and its digest is the SHA-256 of zero bytes, recorded rather than disguised.
prepare_exception.patch_command_base_note: This document's own creating commit adds only its own path and does not modify scripts/prepare_p4_2a_v2_heldout.py, so substituting that commit for f3a5f88fa5346a8c17e7bbf9b1f828598c3056c9 yields byte-identical patch output.

preregistration_deviations.ceiling_rule: evaluated after each recorded failure, but only once the completed-request count has reached 50, so a single failure can never trip the ceiling on an early candidate; the run is terminal when recorded failures exceed 2% of completed requests, and the census is reported with the error

extract_failed_stratum_unchanged.note: the registered stratum already prescribes selected_count 0 and disposition excluded_reported_not_negative; it was unreachable while any candidate failure was terminal, and this narrowing makes it reachable without changing it

recorded_failure_reasons.note: These three reasons are the only ones that describe a completed request whose model answer was then refused by a deterministic, non-retryable check. Each is recorded as one extract_failed row, is reported by id with its category, and counts toward the 2% ceiling. The map is a closed allowlist, so any reason outside it is terminal by construction and needs no further code to stay terminal. A request that was rejected before any answer was produced, or that failed in transport, is not a model answer: no transport-level reason (http_status_429 among them) is accepted here, and this deviation adds none.

still_terminal: any request rejected before an answer was produced or failed in transport, http_status_429 included, because a rejected request is not a model answer
unchanged: candidate pool and eligibility rules including the v4 404/410 rule
request ordering, one request per eligible candidate
zero automatic retries and zero failed-candidate retries

address_is_never_committed.guard: a registered-surface test refuses any URL host outside an explicit allowlist, and any private IPv4 or corp/internal/intra/lan/local hostname, across all seventeen paths
address_is_never_committed.recorded_instead: opaque provider identity plus HMAC-SHA256(salt, base_url + completions_path)
address_is_never_committed.salt_location: operator's gitignored environment only; never in the repository
address_is_never_committed.why_keyed_not_bare: an unsalted digest over a short URL is a guess-verification oracle

checks: the contract file's sha256 equals the registered constant
the contract pins the registered provider identity
hmac.compare_digest against the digest recomputed from live settings
admission_triple.real_path_only_leg: the keyed-digest leg, gated on the production authorization type, under which every injected seam must be None
admission_triple.when: real-stage admission, before any candidate is read

loader_widening.how_it_was_caught: the provider leg of the real-stage admission triple, which compares the contract's provider against the registered constant. The tautological form of that guard, comparing active_provider(settings, contract=contract) against the contract's own provider, would have passed cleanly, because active_provider resolves the contract first and both sides read the same absent value.
loader_widening.second_defect_found_and_fixed: the held-out call path did not forward the contract's provider to the client at all, so the contract's platform pin was ignored even once the contract carried it
loader_widening.what: a held-out wrapper declaring inheritance inference_semantics_byte_frozen may now override a closed allowlist of llm: keys; every other inherited field, above all the prompt and the schema, stays byte-frozen from round 3
loader_widening.why_it_was_needed: Before this change the wrapper named the new model and platform while the contract object the pass actually calls with kept the inherited round-3 values: model qwen3.6-plus, provider None, endpoint_hmac_sha256 None. The pass would therefore have run the previous model, and with no contract pin visible the provider would have fallen back to the process-wide default platform, while every artefact row recorded the new model and the new contract digest from module constants. The rows would have been uniformly and confidently wrong, and no later re-reading of them could have detected it.

differences_and_nothing_else: llm.endpoint replaced by llm.provider and llm.endpoint_hmac_sha256
llm.temperature removed: the platform rejects the field, so sampling temperature is the platform default
llm.response_format -> prompt_enforced_json: the platform has no JSON mode; structured output comes from the prompt plus brace-balanced extraction
llm.total_deadline_seconds 20.0 -> 90.0: measured latency is 7.63 s median with a 26.6 s maximum over thirty calls, and 20 s would trip terminally on the tail

preregistered_values_are_kept_not_rewrit.note: Comparisons against the frozen preregistration keep the preregistered values while the pass runs the deviated ones. Folding the two together would mean either rejecting the frozen document or reading it as though it had been rewritten. The gap between these constants and the active MODEL and HELDOUT_CONTRACT_* values is the deviation itself.

unchanged: candidate pool and eligibility rules including the v4 404/410 rule
request ordering, one request per eligible candidate
zero automatic retries and zero failed-candidate retries

preregistration_deviations.a_resend_is_not_a_candidate_retry: The gateway refused the request before processing it, so the candidate never received an answer. Re-sending produces one answer to one question, not a second sample of the same question. automatic_retries stays 0 and keeps its meaning; the resend counter is separate and separately named.

accounting_identity.requests_started: equals the eligible candidate count plus the resend total

give_up_is_named_never_a_bare_429.mapped_to: a terminal stage failure carrying the reason and the census
give_up_is_named_never_a_bare_429.why: quota exhaustion and a transient blip both surface as HTTP 429; a pass that dies as a generic transport error cannot tell them apart afterwards

preregistration_deviations.honest_residual: honour_retry_after defaults true and the [0, 120] second window with its one-second effective floor takes effect the moment the platform ever sends a delay header. Across sixteen observed rejections the platform sent no Retry-After and no rate-limit headers of any kind, so that path ships exercised only by tests. This is the intended behaviour and is stated here rather than discovered later.
preregistration_deviations.http_status_429_is_not_in_the_acceptance: A rejected request is not a model answer. The three-entry recorded-failure map is unchanged and no transport reason is or becomes acceptable in it.

measured_basis.end_to_end_throughput_with_resends: 429 requests per hour, about 9.2 hours for 3958 candidates
measured_basis.quality_at_65_calls: zero quality failures, no unparseable JSON, no schema violation, no post-validation refusal

registered_caps.constants_not_settings: an operator cannot widen them at runtime

D-11.decision: 撤回 D-10 的分开落地，改为一轮：一份例外文书记录三项偏离，一次实现提交（跨两条线），一次独立复核，一张收据，一次起跑工具重建。
D-11.labelled: reviewer's words, copied from the registered decision file
D-11.scope_not_delegated: 五处契约钉子的具体取值与限流重发的上限值：由复核方按实测提出、业主已就方向拍板；任何进一步放宽仍须业主本人决定

decision.current_pdf_after_pause: the PDF being fetched when the pause fires gets a fresh attempt counter (its attempts restart at 1 after the pause; the pause means the server was unavailable, not that the PDF failed)
decision.evidence: pause_events {pause_index, window_size 20, window_stalls, pause_seconds 600.0, monotonic_offset_seconds, current_url_sha256}; retry_events unchanged; validators require per-url attempt sequences 1..k (k ≤ 11) that may restart at 1 only immediately after a pause event naming that url; retry_count ≤ 11 × (distinct_pdfs + pauses); pause count ≤ 3; window_stalls ≥ 15
decision.limits: at most 3 pauses per materialization; a fourth trigger fails the whole materialization (no partial publish); the 12 h wall-clock cap stands
decision.trigger: sliding window over the last 20 attempts across all PDFs (successes included): when at least 15 of them were transport stalls, record a pause event and sleep 600 s, then clear the window
decision.unchanged: 12 attempts per PDF per healthy period; backoff schedule; transient-only classification; itemised recording; complete-or-nothing; inference zero-retry; extraction failures fatal

D-8.settles: the stall-pause trigger left unreachable by the as-presented '20 consecutive attempts' wording

supersedes_exception.note: the three deviations below are carried forward from it unchanged

defects.why_unsatisfiable: authorization_id required the V6 pattern while verdict required the V5 constant, and validate_preparation_authorization requires the relay verdict to equal the receipt's. A V6 verdict failed the schema and a V5 verdict failed the relay comparison.

defects.now: requires the V6 spellings, which is what the landed v6 review document carries
defects.was: required the review document's schema_version and verdict in their V5 spellings
defects.why_unsatisfiable: _review runs unconditionally and the review path is pinned, so it could never pass

defects.why_a_new_path: _creation requires a registered path to have exactly one touch across --all --full-history, that touch to be a lone A, and the blob to be identical at the creating commit, at HEAD and in the worktree. The v6 review path already has its one creation, so it can be neither modified nor recreated.

release_receipt_path_unchanged.reason: it has never been created, so its one creation is still available to the receipt tool

swept_and_left_alone.reason: prepare reads this constant by reference rather than repeating it, so the two cannot drift. The v5 spelling names the artefact shape, which did not change; renaming it would change published artefact bytes for no reason.
it is compared against what the receipt tool emits, and the two agree. The spelling names a shape, not a release version.
swept_and_left_alone.where: the authority module's build manifest comparison

swept_and_left_alone.reason: the v5 receipt is genuinely what this round supersedes; the v6 receipt was never created
swept_and_left_alone.where: the superseded-release pins in the module, the schema and the test

version_string_repair.why_a_new_exception_document: The gate's base commit must be the exception commit and must sit directly under the implementation commit, so that BASE..implementation equals the registered change set. Reusing the landed v6 exception would put two intervening commits inside that range.
version_string_repair.why_a_new_schema_file_rather_than_an_edi: The landed v6 review document pins the v6 schema's exact bytes in its source_closure, and that review is itself create-only and can never be reissued. Editing the schema in place would leave a landed, immutable document describing bytes that no longer exist. The v6 schema is therefore left untouched and superseded by a new file, which is also the create-only discipline every registered document in this chain has followed.
version_string_repair.why_this_round_exists: The landed v6 could not produce a receipt that any gate would accept. Three version-string literals were wrong, and the receipt tool refused to build rather than emitting one that would fail admission. No scientific term moves: the contract, the model, the registered caps and all three deviations are exactly as landed.
